title: The Paranoia Effect
description: The more you notice it… the more it notices you.
body:

Something is wrong with your world.

You might notice strange messages.
You might see something behind you.

Or maybe nothing will happen at all.

The more you notice it… the more it notices you.

The Paranoia Effect is a singleplayer psychological horror mod that slowly introduces unsettling anomalies into normal Minecraft gameplay. At first everything seems normal, but over time strange events begin appearing throughout your world.

Unusual system-like messages may appear in chat.
Items may behave strangely.
Mysterious figures might appear where they shouldn’t be.

Most of the time nothing happens.

But occasionally something will make you question what you just saw.

This mod focuses on atmosphere, tension, and psychological horror rather than constant action. Many events are rare and unpredictable so that the world always feels uncertain and unsettling.

The longer you survive in your world, the more frequently these anomalies may occur.

Features
<details> <summary>Spoilers / Gameplay Features</summary>

• Stalker Entities
Mysterious entities may appear behind the player or in the distance.

• Chase Encounters
If a stalker is seen, it may begin chasing the player before suddenly vanishing.

• Glitch Messages
Strange system-style messages can appear in chat, resembling corrupted game logs.

• Fake Advancement Notifications
Rarely, the player may receive an advancement message they never actually earned.

• Item Corruption
Items held by the player may occasionally change their name into distorted or glitched text.

• Mysterious Structures
Small houses may appear in the world unexpectedly, sometimes containing something inside.

• Escalating Anomalies
The longer you play, the more likely strange events become.

• Rare Horror Encounters
Unexpected moments designed to create tension and paranoia.

</details>
Recommended Experience

For the best experience:

• Play alone in singleplayer
• Use headphones
• Avoid spoilers

Environment

This mod is designed primarily for singleplayer gameplay, where its unpredictable events and atmosphere can be experienced without outside interference.
